The inner ring segments, labeled with their maximum ambiguity values, are colored: dark blue for Max: 1 (14.2%), medium blue for Max: 2 (35.0%), and light blue for Max: 3 (14.2%). The chart includes a legend on the right side to explain the color coding for both rings. The percentages are displayed directly within each segment of the chart.
